top_signals.title: How the Oil Price Is Pressuring Treasuries
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens says the price of oil has become one of the movers of shorter-duration Treasury yields. He speaks as rising oil prices are bolstering expectations that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
